facts.fact: Law 011/2026 of 26 February 2026 on competition and consumer protection carries a Chapter VI on e-commerce (Articles 41 onward: obligations of an e-commerce enterprise and of an online intermediary) and comes into force on its publication in the Official Gazette, which was on 4 March 2026.
